Follow the manufacturer’s instructions and safety data sheets for each reagent. Biological samples are potentially hazardous and are handled following the facility’s procedures. EnGeL lab rules:

- Before you enter: wear your lab coat, use appropriate gloves, closed shoes only, tie back long hair.
- Not allowed: eating or drinking; touching phones or laptops with contaminated gloves; bags or coats on benches.
- Label all reagents (name, concentration, date) and treat all chemicals as hazardous.
